about.bioText:
I was born in 1982 in sunny Armenia, in the beautiful city of Yerevan.
When I turned 11, my family moved to Russia, to the settlement of Berezovo, where I spent a significant part of my childhood and youth. It was there that I finished secondary school, taking the first steps toward my future.

In 2000, I returned to my hometown Yerevan to continue my education and pursue my creative aspirations. I enrolled in university, where I earned a higher education degree specializing as a fashion designer. My focus was as an artist in the field of fashion and clothing design.

Studying was not just a stage of life for me, but a real start in my professional career, where I was able to combine my love for art, style, and creativity.
achievements: Worked with Lilit Magaryan as a designer
2005 — worked as a manager at Arlekin atelier
